mapper.sql: id, request_id, api_key_id, api_key_name, user_id, model, provider, actual_model, channel_id, channel_name, input_content, output_content, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, finish_reason, error_code, error_message, client_ip, user_agent, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO call_log ( request_id, api_key_id, api_key_name, user_id, model, provider, actual_model, channel_id, channel_name, input_content, output_content, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, finish_reason, error_code, error_message, client_ip, user_agent, created_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{apiKeyId}, #{apiKeyName}, #{userId}, #{model}, #{provider}, #{actualModel}, #{channelId}, #{channelName}, #{inputContent}, #{outputContent}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{finishReason}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM call_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT model, COUNT(*) as call_count, SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as error_count FROM call_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY model ORDER BY call_count DESC

SELECT channel_name, provider, COUNT(*) as call_count, SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as error_count FROM call_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name, provider ORDER BY call_count DESC

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as call_count, SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as error_count FROM call_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM call_log WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL AND created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
